summary.text: Chris Head is a Republican member of the Senate of Virginia for District 3, serving since 2024. The Senate's member page lists committee assignments including Education and Health, General Laws and Technology, and Rehabilitation and Social Services.

paragraphs.text: Christopher T. Head was born in Commerce, Georgia, on January 13, 1963, according to the Senate's member page.
The page says he earned a bachelor's degree in music from the University of Georgia in 1985 and lists his occupation as business owner.
The page lists him as a member of the House from 2012 to 2024 and a member of the Senate since 2024.
It lists his memberships as including the Roanoke Regional Chamber of Commerce and the Roanoke Symphony Board of Directors.
